item.title: Ryan Routh Sentenced to Life in Prison for Trying to Assassinate Trump
item.description: Ryan Routh, who attempted to assassinate Donald Trump at his golf club in West Palm Beach, Florida, in September 2024, was sentenced Wednesday to life in prison. The ruling was handed down by U.S. District Judge Aileen Cannon, a Trump appointee who has a history of biased rulings in favor of the president. item.title: Trans People Saw the Nancy Mace Crack-Up Coming Long, Long Ago
item.description: When New York magazine published an investigative report that found Republican Representative Nancy Mace had engaged in abusive, alcoholic, and inappropriate behavior with her staff, it came as no surprise to me. item.title: DOJ Removes ICE Attorney Who Said “This Job Sucks” in Court
item.description: The Justice Department attorney who told a Minnesota judge Tuesday to hold her in contempt because “this job sucks” has been removed from her post. Julie Le was filling in at the U.S. Attorney’s Office in Minnesota to help with a heavy caseload as immigrants challenge their detentions. item.title: Supreme Court Lets California’s New Map Stand in Blow to Trump
item.description: The Supreme Court ruled Wednesday to allow California to use a newly drawn congressional map that could earn Democrats as many as five additional House seats in the upcoming midterm elections. item.title: Trump Admin Investigates Nike for Discrimination Against White People
